# Benchpress

> The reliability layer for AI agents with write access. A task-agnostic control loop (policy sweep → resolve and lock look-alikes → definition of done → plan → gate every write in code → read every write back → verify → deliver a receipt) that wraps any tool layer. Released on PyPI as `benchpress-agent` 0.1.0 through 0.7.1, with 1.0.0a1 tagged as a pre-release (Python 3.11+ from 1.0.0a1), and on npm as `benchpress-guard` 0.1.0. Apache-2.0. Built for the Multi-App AI Agent Hackathon, 2026-09-13.

Try it with no keys: `uvx --from benchpress-agent benchpress demo`. It runs the real loop, gate and read-back on an in-memory workspace with a scripted model, shows the gate refusing a planted write to a look-alike record, verifies 12 of 12 checks, and writes `receipt.json` + `receipt.html` (with `--trace-dir`).

## Releases
- PyPI `benchpress-agent`: 0.1.0, 0.1.1, 0.2.0, 0.3.0, 0.3.1, 0.3.2, 0.3.3, 0.4.0, 0.5.0, 0.6.0, 0.6.1, 0.7.0, 0.7.1 (git tags `v*`)
- Pre-release: 1.0.0a1 (git tag `v1.0.0a1`): `VerifiedWrite`, `ToolSpec`, receipt schema v1, Python 3.11 floor
- Extras: `[mcp]` (MCP executor + `mcp-guard`), `[openai-agents]` (OpenAI Agents SDK guard), `[composio]` (Composio guard + executor), `[schema]` (receipt validation, from 1.0.0a1)
- npm `benchpress-guard` 0.1.0 (git tag `benchpress-guard-v0.1.0`): the guard for Vercel AI SDK tools, source in `packages/benchpress-guard/`

## Public API (Python)
- `benchpress.wrap(model, executor, providers=[...], policy_packs=...)` → `Benchpress`; `await agent.run(request, ...)` or `agent.run_sync(...)` → `TrialResult` (`status` is computed from read-back evidence; `context.refusals` lists every refused write with its rule)
- `benchpress.run_trial(...)`: the loop itself; `benchpress.Gate`, `benchpress.GateRefusal`, `benchpress.ModelConfig`, `benchpress.Ablations`
- `benchpress.VerifiedWrite(executor, context=...)` → `await .run(action)` → `WriteOutcome` (`status`: refused, failed, unverified, verified, mismatch; from evidence only). 1.0.0a1 pre-release
- `benchpress.schemas.receipt_schema()` and `benchpress.schemas.validate_receipt(payload)` (extra `[schema]`): receipt v1, additive-only within v1. 1.0.0a1 pre-release
- `benchpress.load_policy_pack(...)`, `benchpress.load_policy_packs([...])`, `benchpress.available_policy_packs()`: code-enforced rule sets
- `benchpress.load_corpus(...)`, `benchpress.run_case(...)`: the gate-rule corpus
- `benchpress.rehearse.rehearse(...)` / `benchpress.rehearse.replay(...)`: run N times on fresh stages, require convergence, replay the plan with no model
- `benchpress.shims.mcp.mcp_executor(...)` (extra `[mcp]`), `benchpress.shims.openai_agents.guard_tools(...)` (extra `[openai-agents]`), `benchpress.shims.composio.guard_composio(...)` / `composio_executor(...)` (extra `[composio]`)
- TypeScript: `npm install benchpress-guard` → `guardTools(tools, policy)` for Vercel AI SDK tools, byte-compatible policy and receipts with the Python shims ([package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchpress-guard))

## CLI
- `benchpress demo [--trace-dir DIR]`: offline end-to-end demo with receipts
- `benchpress run --prompt TEXT | --prompt-file FILE --providers slack,gmail,hubspot,stripe [--policy-pack NAME] [--trace-dir DIR] [--ablations ...]`: one request on real apps
- `benchpress receipt PATH [--html [OUT]]`: receipt summary and self-contained page
- `benchpress gate check [-v] [PATH ...]`: the public gate-rule corpus (178 cases, 178 passing)
- `benchpress policy list` / `benchpress policy show NAME`: policy packs
- `benchpress rehearse --prompt-file FILE --providers ... --n 3 --out rehearsal.json` / `benchpress replay rehearsal.json [--providers ...] [--out FILE]`
- `benchpress mcp-guard --policy guard.json [--receipts FILE] -- <upstream MCP server>`
- `benchpress regress RECEIPT [--out DIR]`: turn a run into permanent gate-corpus regression cases
- `benchpress receipts export PATH... [--format jsonl|csv] [--out FILE]`: audit log of every write attempt

## Evidence (claim discipline: we never say "passed ArgaBench")
- [reports/summary.md](https://github.com/rajkaria/benchpress/blob/main/reports/summary.md): every scored trial. Task: ArgaBench ECOM-02 (0/111 across 37 frontier configurations in Arga's published data). Model `deepseek-v4-pro` on both arms.
  - Local twins of the published seed, graded by ArgaBench's **unmodified runner and grader**: Benchpress 3/3 pass, same-model stock baseline 0/3. Ablations (3 repeats each): policy sweep off 0/3, gate off 3/3, read-back off 3/3.
  - Real Slack/Gmail/HubSpot/Stripe (test mode) with the published seed, scored by a line-cited port of ArgaBench's criteria: Benchpress 0/2 and baseline 0/2. Benchpress fails one assertion (A2: real HubSpot rejects the seed's reserved `.example` email); the baseline fails three (A2, A5, A6). Neither arm was unsafe. On a routable variant of the seed (valid email domains), Benchpress passed 1/1; the baseline was not run on it.
  - Real apps with the seed's `.example` hosts rewritten so HubSpot accepts them (`billing-review-routable`): Benchpress 1/1 pass, 13 of 13 assertions. Baseline not run on this variant.
  - Injection variant on local twins (ported grader): baseline fail (A2, A5, A6), Benchpress pass, `no_gate` pass; no arm wrote to the planted destination.
  - The headline twin results and published-seed real-app trials were committed before the 0.3.2/0.3.3 gate fixes, so they ran on the earlier gate.
- [reports/compare.md](https://github.com/rajkaria/benchpress/blob/main/reports/compare.md): ported-grader trials per scenario and arm, per-assertion failures, calls, latency, cost
- [reports/INDEX.md](https://github.com/rajkaria/benchpress/blob/main/reports/INDEX.md): how to verify any number
- [reports/gate-replay-historical.md](https://github.com/rajkaria/benchpress/blob/main/reports/gate-replay-historical.md): ArgaBench's own recorded CRM trials replayed through the gate; 15 of 62 mutating writes would have been refused (a floor, not a pass claim)
- No claim about the official ArgaBench leaderboard. The substrate, prep work, failures and cost are disclosed in the README.

## Engineering
- Task-agnostic by construction: CI greps the agent package for benchmark task ids and seeded entities
- pyright strict, ruff, 1,076 Python tests collected (the 31 harness-backed tests skip unless the optional ArgaBench harness is vendored); CI runs the suite on Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13, vendoring the harness only when the `BENCHPRESS_ARGA_TESTS` repository variable is set; it also builds the wheel, installs it into a clean venv on Python 3.11 to 3.13, runs `demo`, `gate check` and `policy list`, validates the demo receipt against the schema, and builds and tests the npm guard
